admission.justification: Inherited AR roots, Git redirections or caller-session identity can make a disposable child operate on live state or join its parent chat; explicit environment scrub prevents these errors while retaining logins.

applicability: Processes launched through the PNT sandbox Operations seam.
conditions: The selected sandbox command is running on Linux with readable process or source observations; otherwise its named refusal applies.
exclusions: Harness logins and home selectors intentionally remain and can use files outside the sandbox.
A harness-created tool server receives these values only if the harness forwards them or the launch definition carries them.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_pnt_sandbox.py::BuildInputTests::test_the_environment_loses_what_selects_another_runtime_and_keeps_logins; worker evidence 15-process-environment-and-files.txt, 31-g5-session-variables.txt; review R1 [05-env]; review R2 [02-env]; member table FAM-4 in section 3.3

statement: Every process the sandbox starts receives the caller's environment without the variables that select another AR runtime, coordination root, repository or Paseo home (every name starting `PASEO_`, `AR_`, `AGENTS_REMEMBER_` or `ORCA_`; `PYTHONPATH`, `PYTHONHOME`, `VIRTUAL_ENV`, `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT`; seven `GIT_` redirections) and without the variables that tie a process to the harness session the command was run from (`TMUX`, `TMUX_PANE`, `OLDPWD`, `AI_AGENT`, fourteen `CLAUDE` names and two `CODEX` names, each by exact name), with `TMUX_TMPDIR`, `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX`, `GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0` and `AR_DAGGER_AUTHORITY_ROOT` set to the sandbox's own values and `PWD` set to the child's working directory; harness logins, credentials and home selectors are kept, and nothing is removed by the `CLAUDE_`, `CLAUDE_CODE_` or `CODEX_` prefix.
